# Royal collectibles and the secret ending

- Original source: [Royal collectibles and the secret ending](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=792309796)
- Author / publication: xXDylanXWithinXx / Steam Community
- Language / date: English; published 2016-11-02; updated 2022-06-01
- Access: Page text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The guide maps royal objects to missions:

| Mission | Royal object |
| --- | --- |
| The Prince and the Outlaw | Sceptre |
| The Evening Visitor | Domesday Book |
| The Lock-up and the Friar | Coronation Spoon |
| The Silver Arrow | Sword of State |
| A Wedding and a Funeral | Ampulla |
| The Escape | Royal seal |
| The Letter | Crown |

Some pickups require dialogue progression, a particular guard's defeat, or beggar information. Consult the original for locations.

**Terminology caution:** its numbering includes the Silver Arrow alongside royal regalia. The scoring guide treats them differently. Ending-condition code was not verified.
